description: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site is a data repository run by Tokyo Metropolitan Government. The catalogue lists open data of the metropolis in CSV, XLSX and geodata formats, including evacuation sites, transport, water and sewer, waste and disaster-prevention data, with a CKAN-style API. Coverage: Tokyo metropolis. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as csv, xlsx, geojson; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("東京都オープンデータカタログサイトホームページ") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support urban infrastructure and disaster-preparedness studies of Tokyo. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
